# N43 sample files

Sample Norma 43 files from other open source parsers. Each folder keeps the
original license of its source.

| File | Source | License |
|------|--------|---------|
| `sequra/example1.n43` | [sequra/norma43_parser](https://github.com/sequra/norma43_parser/blob/fc7f979342a7c1cff632651c4607ffc95c0aa292/spec/fixtures/example1.n43) | MIT, see `sequra/LICENSE` |
| `sequra/example2.n43` | [sequra/norma43_parser](https://github.com/sequra/norma43_parser/blob/fc7f979342a7c1cff632651c4607ffc95c0aa292/spec/fixtures/example2.n43) | MIT, see `sequra/LICENSE` |
| `sergief/movements.n43` | [sergief/norma43parser](https://github.com/sergief/norma43parser/blob/21ea831a782f2bef3110d2253cf9a7c7c4aec126/norma43parser/test/fixtures/movements.n43) | MIT, see `sergief/LICENSE` |

The files are byte-for-byte copies. Do not change their line endings.
